title: Minimum fill height to prevent flotation
readable: H_min B_c (w_s - w_o) + W_c = (π/4) B_c^2 w_o

symbols.definition: Minimum height of fill material in m
Saturated density of the soil in kg/m³
Unit weight of the empty pipe in kg/linear metre and
Outside width of the conduit in m.

applicability: Under submergence, minimum fill height required to prevent flotation, ignoring frictional forces in the fill. Wherever sufficient height of fill is not available, anti-flotation blocks should be provided (Example IX in Appendix A.3.8).
notes: Transcriber note: the raster formula uses an o-like subscript on water density; the native definition is printed as w_0. Both locators are retained in this representation without altering the formula.
